host.description: Hostname or IP address to bind to. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port on which the GRAM Job Manager service listens.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_operations.description: Maximum number of concurrent job management operations (e.g., cancel, status).

gridftp_server.description: Host:port of the GridFTP server used for data staging. Leave empty if not used.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for job submission and status queries.

verbose_logging.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

job_spool_dir.description: Directory for spooling job metadata and temporary files.

job_state_cache_size.description: Maximum number of job state records kept in memory for fast lookup.

allowed_resource_managers.description: List of names of resource managers permitted to accept jobs from this manager (e.g., PBS, SLURM).

use_credential_renewal.description: Enable automatic GSI proxy credential renewal via gssproxy.

credential_renewal_config.description: Path to the gssproxy configuration file (used only if credential renewal is enabled).

environment.description: Environment variables to export to all job processes. Each entry specifies name=value.

job_wrappers.description: Scripts to invoke before (pre) or after (post) each job execution.

type.description: When to run the wrapper script: before ('pre') or after ('post') job execution

auth_method.description: Authentication mechanism. Options: 'proxy' (GSI proxy), 'gridmap' (user mapping), or 'x509_proxy' (direct proxy path).

proxy_path.description: Path to the GSI proxy certificate file (used only when AuthMethod = 'x509_proxy').

enable_job_aggregation.description: Enable batch submission of multiple jobs in one request.

max_jobs_per_batch.description: Maximum number of jobs per aggregation batch (used only if job aggregation is enabled).
